svg.title: LAF-YOLOv10 composability study
svg.desc: Four modules tested one at a time change mAP@0.5 by -2.0, +1.0, -2.5 and +0.5 (sum -3.0), but stacked they lose 5.5 points, a -2.5 interaction penalty concentrated in the P2/-P5 head swap. Only 73 of 150 backbone tensors load from the COCO checkpoint, and TIDE shows the gap is missed detections (+15.4) and classification errors (+7.7).
svg.text: LAF-YOLOv10 · do four validated upgrades add up?
Measured over 3 seeds on VisDrone-DET2019: 24.0 ± 0.4% mAP@0.5 vs 31.8% for unmodified YOLOv10n.
Alone: one module added to the baseline
Where accuracy went: TIDE error shift
